{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
# Conversion rate = proportion of orders with converted == 1, within each segment
conversion_rate = df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean().round(4)

# Get the segment with the highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rate.idxmax()
best_rate = conversion_rate.max()

# Output the result
print(f"Conversion rates by segment:\n{conversion_rate}")
print(f"\nHighest conversion rate: {best_segment} ({best_rate})")"}
